situation (example wording): "Murders in Chicago from 1990 to 2024" (a span one source covers and another covers only in part)
what the app does today: Each tab reads only its own data; no rule for a span only another source covers.
proposed behavior: Never join two sources in one series. Answer from the one source that covers the whole span with the same measure and filters (here Historical, for murders) and name it; if none does, answer the covered part and name the missing years (frozen rule 4).
exact default or choices offered: Source: the one covering the whole span; otherwise the covered years, with the gap named.
why: Sources count differently; a joined series shows jumps that are not real.
